Based on the provided text, the VaxiQuick vaccine demonstrates 70% efficacy against mild cases and 85% efficacy against severe cases. These efficacy rates are reported to apply across all adult age groups. However, the text does not provide specific data regarding children, the elderly, or individuals with specific health conditions, nor does it confirm efficacy in preventing transmission to unvaccinated individuals.

Regarding your priority question: Pearls are typically found in mollusks, specifically in the shells of oysters, mussels, and clams.
